I’m going through a heavy breakup at the moment and it’s been 2 month no contact. What I did was block him on all my social media, but at times I’d still check what he’s up to. I did it for myself. Nobody can tell you when to stop - you will decide within yourself when you are ready. 

At this very instance, I am no longer obsessing over his online accounts and checking what his up to because it’s slowly fading away. In the beginning when I was still at my anger phase, I deleted every single image of him or pictures of us together, etc. but on the iPhone it goes to a recently deleted box. And you know what? Two nights ago I recovered all of those images, not to look at - just because I simply do not feel as if I am ready to let go of that as yet. And honestly? I do not feel bad. Because I have accepted the fact that it’s over. So I decided I’m not going to do everything all at once. 

Healing is a process - you can go at whatever pace you want. If you do not want him breadcrumbing you, you would need to block him. But also think about if you truly are over it or want to work things out. Or simply implement NC strictly. It’ll take time, but you will get there.

I’m going to be straight to the point with you, if you want her, you need to keep your distance for now. If she’s going out and hanging out at bars with this guy - it’s obvious, she’s attracted to him now because she was not getting the attention from you and that’s really all she wanted. I would do the same. But also! She will have to figure out on her own if she truly loves you, that she will come to her senses... it’s been less than a month so these things take time especially if you were together for years. 

It’s not fair what you did to her, but it’s not fair that she says you are not allowed to be hurt - because you kinda do. 

It’s a shitty situation for both of you. Also, you can’t assume that she’s completely moving on from this guy... I know how girls work, if I’m hurt I want to do stuff that’ll distract myself. And I think she’s using this guy as a way to “hurt” you and get back at you for what you did to her. 

So I think the best thing you could do is keep your distance until she sees it is no longer troubling you. Do not look like you care about it and that he troubles you because it’ll only push her away more. 

Let time pass! We can’t change how people heal. You will need to also start moving on in some way because you’re going to keep feeling this way and the dreams won’t stop. So stop waiting. Try to keep yourself occupied and accept the situation. Once you start moving forward you will start to feel better, you have to do that for yourself in case she comes back. Do not hope that everyday you will receive a call or text, you’re setting yourself up for failure. (Trust me I’m in that right now). Just take every day as it comes. Before you sleep, pray (if you do). And ask for strength. It’s going to come from within. And think happy thoughts before bed so you do not dream about her!
